cds.title: Grand Valley State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (XLSX)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025). International = the 'Nonresident' rows of C1: 1,060 applied, 872 admitted (82%), only 34 enrolled. Undergrad total and nonresident count are B1/B2 'Total undergraduates' (19,154; nonresident 241). No waitlist, early decision or early action; no application closing date (rolling) and no application fee. SAT/ACT percentiles are for enrolled students who submitted scores (SAT 2,350 students = 54.2% of 4,335; ACT 129 = 3.0%, so the ACT figures rest on few students). C11 GPA ranges were split by test submitters vs non-submitters and left blank for all enrolled students, so gpa_distribution is omitted; mean GPA 3.40 is C12.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8 (fall 2027): SAT or ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1 first-year; the CDS flags that final 2026-27 charges were not yet available, so the cycle file's figures from the tuition page replace these. H6: 222 nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates received institutional aid, average $9,304.
